coreMemory.english: n. the importance or usefulness of something；v. to consider someone or something important
coreMemory.structure: great value /ɡreɪt ˈvæljuː/（很大价值）；value for money /ˈvæljuː fɔr mʌni/（物有所值）；place a value on /pleɪs ə ˈvæljuː ɑn/（为……估价；重视）；core values /kɔr væljuz/（核心价值观）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use value with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of value in context；❌ translate value word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “great value”

commonErrors.wrong: use value with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ˈvæljuː wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of value in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˈvæljuː ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。
不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。

coreMemory.directAntonym: lack of value /læk ʌv vælju/（与“价值”意义相反）
